verdict.rationale: Devin's MCP docs state that users can "set up schedules" and that scheduling "supports cron expressions for recurring schedules, one-time scheduling, notification preferences, and agent selection". This directly covers recurring jobs, and any MCP-compatible agent or IDE gets access to the scheduling feature. Missing for 10: a dedicated scheduling guide beyond brief mentions on the MCP page, detail on how scheduled sessions run and are monitored, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
